backtest.note: Tested Oct 20 2026 on every priced side since 2023-24 at early Bet365 prices. The model's own edges lost the closing line most of the time, so plays now need Pinnacle's fair price to call the bet price value, with the model agreeing. Bet365 rarely strays from Pinnacle, so few bets qualified in testing; US books like Hard Rock and DraftKings stray more often, which is where this rule should find its plays.
